english.title: Place thing outside detention centre for detained person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) placed a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..), outside a detention centre, namely **(..SPECIFY CENTRE..), intending it to come into the possession of a detained person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), and was not as a result guilty of an offence under paragraph 4 or 5 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 6(2) and (3) of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 4 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 concerns assisting detained persons to escape from a detention centre or short-term holding facility.
(ii) Paragraph 5 of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 relates to bringing alcohol into a detention centre or to a detained person.
